section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a study on women's health conducted in two locations: Harare, Zimbabwe and London. Participants were recruited using opportunistic sampling in Harare and snowball sampling in London, with age-matched samples of Zimbabwean women. All participants completed paper-and-pencil surveys with counterbalanced scale presentation and provided informed consent.
